title: 变色的本事
subtitle: 躲起来，或者说句话
character: wearing a lime green t-shirt, khaki shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, bold flat graphic art with thick outlines and flat fills, jungle green, coral and warm sand, simple chunky shapes, the illustration covers the entire image area

pages.zh:
书上有一张照片，
我看了半天
才找到那只虫子。
它和树叶一个颜色。
它是怎么做到的？
pages.scene: The little boy leans over an open picture book at a table, peering closely at one page, searching.

pages.zh:
很多动物会「伪装」。
意思是让自己
看起来像周围的东西，
这样别人就不容易
发现它。
pages.scene: One leaf-shaped insect resting on a leafy background on a cream page, almost the same colour as the leaves around it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有的靠天生的花纹。
斑马的条纹，
豹子的斑点，
跟草和树影混在一起，
远看就糊成一片。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two panels side by side on a cream background: the left with vertical stripes over a striped background, the right with round spots over a dappled background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
变色龙不一样。
它的皮肤里
有很多装着色素的小袋子。
袋子张开或者收拢，
颜色就变了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two rows of small round sacs on a cream background: in the top row each sac is small and tight, in the bottom row each is spread wide and flat. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
章鱼更厉害。
它不但能变色，
还能把皮肤
变得粗糙或者光滑，
连形状都学得像。
pages.scene: One octopus on a cream background resting against a rough rocky surface, its skin bumpy and the same colour as the rock. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
变色不只是为了躲。
有时候是在说话：
生气了变深，
求偶了变鲜艳，
吓唬别人就变得很花。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three identical animal outlines in a row on a cream background, filled with three clearly different patterns: plain dark, bright even colour, and bold irregular blotches. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有的动物反过来。
它们颜色特别鲜艳，
就是要让人看见：
我有毒，别吃我。
pages.scene: One small bright frog on a cream background, drawn in a single vivid colour against a plain dark leaf. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
还有的装成别人。
没有毒的蝴蝶
长得像有毒的那种，
鸟就不敢碰它。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two butterfly outlines side by side on a cream background with exactly the same wing pattern, one marked with a small warning triangle and one without. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
颜色从哪来的呢？
有的是色素，
像颜料一样；
有的是靠皮肤上的细纹
把光反射成彩色。
pages.scene: One feather on a cream background, half drawn in flat colour and half showing fine parallel lines that catch the light. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以有些鸟的蓝色
其实不是蓝颜料。
把羽毛磨碎，
蓝色就没了，
因为细纹被磨坏了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two feathers side by side on a cream background: the left one whole with fine lines drawn on it, the right one crushed into a small heap with no lines. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我们也会伪装。
军装是绿的和棕的，
消防服是亮黄的。
一个为了藏起来，
一个为了被看见。
pages.scene: Two folded garments side by side on a cream background: one in muted green and brown, one in bright yellow. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我又看了一遍那张照片。
这回一下子就找到了。
那只虫子还在那儿，
一动不动。
它一直都在。
pages.scene: The little boy points at one spot on the open book page, smiling, having found the insect.
